Record Class ProblemSpec

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
org.uma.evolver.cli.training.ProblemSpec
Record Components:
className - a name registered in ProblemRegistry's curated catalogue (e.g. "ZDT1"), or a fully-qualified class name (e.g. "org.uma.jmetal.problem.multiobjective.wfg.WFG1")
args - constructor arguments, in order; empty for a no-arg constructor
public record ProblemSpec(String className, List<Object> args) extends Record
Identifies a training problem: a class (a short, curated name registered in ProblemRegistry, or a fully-qualified class name resolved by reflection) plus the constructor arguments it needs, if any.

Most jMetal problems (ZDT1, DTLZ3, RE31, ...) have a no-arg constructor, so the common case is just a name with empty args. Parametrized problems (DTLZ/WFG/ZCAT with an explicit number of variables/objectives) or ones that need external data (a TSP instance file) pass whatever their constructor expects as args; ProblemRegistry.resolve(ProblemSpec) matches them against a constructor by arity. A user's own Problem class works the same way — a fully-qualified class name resolved by reflection — as long as it is on the runtime classpath; no Evolver code change is needed to use it.
